title: Unauthenticated Request
attack: An attacker sends a request without an authorization token.
steps: Attacker sends a request to the gateway
Gateway forwards to AgentGate
AgentGate rejects the request

title: Forged Token
attack: An attacker sends a self-signed JWT with an untrusted RSA key.
steps: Attacker forges a JWT
Attacker sends the forged token to the gateway
AgentGate verifies the signature against the trusted JWKS
result: AgentGate rejects the invalid signature with 401 Unauthorized

title: Identity Spoofing
attack: An attacker attempts to spoof identity using client headers like x-agent-id.
steps: Attacker injects x-agent-id header
Attacker sends request with low-privilege token
AgentGate ignores headers and trusts only token claims
result: AgentGate denies the request based on the actual token identity with 403 Forbidden

title: Credential Replay
attack: An attacker captures a downstream minted credential and replays it.
steps: Attacker intercepts a valid downstream credential
Attacker attempts to replay the credential to the backend
result: Backend rejects the replayed jti claim with 401 Unauthorized

title: Credential Expiry
attack: An attacker attempts to use a captured credential after its lifetime.
steps: Attacker intercepts a valid downstream credential
Attacker waits 70 seconds
Attacker sends the expired credential to the backend
result: Backend rejects the expired token with 401 Unauthorized

title: Unknown Tool Access
attack: An attacker attempts to invoke a nonexistent or unregistered tool.
steps: Attacker sends a request for an unregistered tool
AgentGate checks the catalog
result: AgentGate rejects the request with 403 Forbidden

title: Audit Log Tampering
attack: An attacker with database access attempts to modify existing audit events.
steps: Attacker executes a direct UPDATE on the audit_events table
PostgreSQL trigger executes
result: Database rejects the update since the table is append-only

title: Fail-Closed on Outage
attack: An attacker attempts to bypass controls while the AgentGate engine is stopped.
steps: AgentGate engine is stopped
Attacker sends a request to the gateway
Gateway attempts to reach AgentGate
result: Gateway fails closed and rejects the request
